answer: The marble holds work receipts rather than names, so the lagoon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
